review.title: Weekly review
review.note: What worked? One tiny tweak for next week?
streak.rule: One missed day is fine. Never miss twice.
ai.off.sub: Everything else works without it. Add an API key on the server to turn on the coach and scans.
ai.err.limit: Daily AI limit reached. Back tomorrow.
ai.err.network: Can't reach the AI right now.
ai.err.provider: The AI had a problem. Try again.
scan.fail: Couldn't analyze that photo. Try another.
scan.subjective: Subjective AI feedback, not a validated measurement.
scan.cloud: This photo is sent once to the AI for feedback and not stored on any server.
scan.sensitive: Thanks for sharing that. How you're feeling matters more than any photo. If food, your body or your mood feel heavy right now, please consider talking with a doctor, therapist or someone you trust. You deserve support. 💛
consent.title: Before you scan
consent.2: Posture runs on your phone. The photo never leaves it.
consent.3: Physique and outfit photos are sent once to an AI provider for feedback and are not stored on a server.
consent.4: Posture results are a general screening, not a diagnosis. AI feedback is subjective, not a measurement.
posture.local: Runs on-device. Nothing leaves your phone.
posture.how.side: Stand relaxed, full body from the side, camera at chest height.
posture.how.front: Stand relaxed, shoulders visible, facing the camera.
posture.none: No person detected. Try a clearer full-body photo.
posture.disclaimer: General screening only, not a diagnosis. For pain or concerns, see a professional.
tip.head: Head sits forward: tuck your chin gently and raise screens to eye level.
tip.trunk: Trunk leans: stand tall, ribs over hips, soften the knees.
tip.shoulder: Shoulders uneven: alternate the bag shoulder and stretch the tighter side.
tip.ok: Alignment looks within a typical range. Nice.
tip.g1: Take a 1-minute posture break every 30-45 minutes.
tip.g2: Strengthen your upper back (rows, face pulls) 2+ days a week.
tip.g3: Set up your screen at eye level.
gal.local: Photos are stored only on this device.
gal.empty: No photos yet. Save one from Physique.
